blurb: A bad credential is presented to one member's seam, so on an actor sum `by Forged`, `by Expired`, `by Stale` and `by Revoked` must say which member's refusal the case checks, when more than one member could refuse it. Name the member in parentheses, as `by Forged(Browser)`. The name is a bare member name of the handler's `by` sum, not a value: an actor's identity is a value (`by Browser("ada")`), a bad credential carries none. A member that cannot refuse the credential is refused with the principal's own error.
summary: A case drives `by Forged`, `by Expired`, `by Stale` or `by Revoked` at an actor sum with more than one member that could refuse it, without naming the member (`by Forged(Browser)`).
